dish.title: Ethiopian Berbere Beef Tibs
dish.description: Cubed beef quickly sautéed with onion, garlic, ginger, and berbere until deeply spiced and browned, finished with tomato and herbs. Served with rice or greens (injera optional if available).

recipe_version.title: Ethiopian Berbere Beef Tibs
recipe_version.description: Cubed beef quickly sautéed with onion, garlic, ginger, and berbere until deeply spiced and browned, finished with tomato and herbs. Served with rice or greens (injera optional if available).

ingredients.name: beef sirloin
ingredients.note: trimmed; cut into 3/4-inch cubes. Meat allergen.

ingredients.name: berbere
ingredients.note: HARD SPICE CONTRACT. Ethiopian berbere blend (chili, fenugreek, coriander, cardamom, etc.). Not chili powder alone and not garam masala. Reduce to 1 tbsp for milder.

ingredients.name: smoked paprika
ingredients.note: supports color if berbere is mild; still use berbere as primary

ingredients.name: ground cardamom
ingredients.note: optional boost if berbere is light on cardamom; still count berbere as the lead spice

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.note: about 6 oz; or 1/2 cup diced canned tomato, drained

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: divided: 2 tbsp to sear beef, 1 tbsp for onion

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 3/4 tsp on beef, 1/2 tsp with onions

ingredients.name: cooked rice or sautéed greens
ingredients.display_name: cooked rice or sautéed greens, for serving
ingredients.note: about 1 cup cooked rice or wilted greens per person. Injera is optional if available locally — not required by this package and not listed as a shopping dependency.

steps.title: Cube and season the beef
steps.body: Pat the beef dry. Cut into 3/4-inch cubes. Toss with 3/4 tsp kosher salt, black pepper, and 1 tbsp of the berbere. Rest 10 minutes at room temperature while you slice the onions and mince garlic and ginger. Dice the tomato. Chop the cilantro. Juice the lime. Confirm berbere is an Ethiopian blend, not plain chili powder.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp of the neutral oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high until shimmering. Add the beef in a single layer (two batches if needed). Sear undisturbed until deeply browned on the first side, about 2 to 3 minutes. Toss and sear until browned on most sides but still pink inside, about 2 minutes more. Transfer beef to a plate. Do not cook through yet.

steps.title: Cook the onion berbere base
steps.body: Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the same skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and 1/2 tsp kosher salt. Cook, stirring, until onions soften and pick up browned bits, about 6 to 8 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, remaining 1 tbsp berbere, smoked paprika, and optional cardamom. Cook until fragrant and brick-red, about 1 minute. Stir in the diced tomato. Cook until the tomato softens into the onions, about 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Finish tibs and plate
steps.body: Return the seared beef and any plate juices to the skillet. Toss over medium-high heat until the beef is coated and cooked to medium (about 135–140 F for cubes), about 2 to 3 minutes. Do not stew into a long braise — tibs stay skillet-quick. Off heat, stir in lime juice and cilantro. Serve over cooked rice or sautéed greens. Injera on the side is optional if you have it; it is not required. No yogurt sauce. No nuts. kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.heat: Medium-high to sear beef; medium for onion base; medium-high to finish. No oven. No grill required.
recipe_version.doneness: Beef cubes browned outside, medium inside (~135–140 F). Onions soft and brick-red with berbere. Tomato melted into the base. Not a long braise. kitchen_tested is false.
